{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] Nesquik chocolate-flavored drink powder (or any other brand of milkshake powder or liquid)
*1½ tbsp powdered creamer
*3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*Hot [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==

#Put all ingredients in a glass or cup.
#Stir in hot water to achieve desired consistency.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can make it ¾ cup of hot water, then ¼ cold water, and put in ice cubes.
* The hot variation recipe is good with breakfast.
